{"diagnosis": "Fetch TB reports `TRAP: no progress max_addr=0x00000000` vs expected advancing PC/fetch progress (fingerprint 938a85fe28aa). Root cause in picorv32.v:376 `mem_done` uses `&& (&mem_state && mem_do_rinst)` instead of `||`, requiring both `mem_xfer && |mem_state` and `&mem_state` simultaneously so `mem_done` never asserts in normal states and the fetch FSM stalls at addr 0.",
"patch_diff": "diff --git a/picorv32.v b/picorv32.v
--- a/picorv32.v
+++ b/picorv32.v
@@ -375,7 +375,7 @@
 	wire mem_busy = |{mem_do_prefetch, mem_do_rinst, mem_do_rdata, mem_do_wdata};
-	wire mem_done = resetn && ((mem_xfer && |mem_state && (mem_do_rinst || mem_do_rdata || mem_do_wdata)) && (&mem_state && mem_do_rinst)) &&
+	wire mem_done = resetn && ((mem_xfer && |mem_state && (mem_do_rinst || mem_do_rdata || mem_do_wdata)) || (&mem_state && mem_do_rinst)) &&
 			(!mem_la_firstword || (~&mem_rdata_latched[1:0] && mem_xfer));
",
"expected": "tohost PASS (not FAIL 0xdead), no `no progress max_addr=0x00000000` trap with progress/max_addr advancing, checksum != 563b7c10626ff25de2b3c430956c7c113e448c4efaea068f9b83a198d4322b15"}
